subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose host update execution through an HTTP admin surface, and if so should that be `update.run` on the existing default-off `admin-http-rpc` plugin, a dedicated endpoint, or no HTTP update surface?
rationale: The source shows the update primitive exists but is intentionally absent from the HTTP admin allowlist; choosing to expose it changes a privileged operator boundary and cannot be settled by automation.

options.title: Allowlist update.run in admin-http-rpc
options.body: Expose `update.run` only through the existing default-off authenticated admin HTTP RPC plugin, with docs/tests/proof and no new always-on route.

options.title: Version-only now
options.body: Handle the health version field through the narrower canonical issue and keep update execution limited to CLI/WebSocket surfaces for now.

options.title: Dedicated update endpoint
options.body: Add a purpose-built HTTP update route if maintainers want a simpler fleet API, accepting the extra core API and security-review surface.

recommendation.title: Allowlist update.run in admin-http-rpc
recommendation.body: Expose `update.run` only through the existing default-off authenticated admin HTTP RPC plugin, with docs/tests/proof and no new always-on route.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent review and verification history on the privileged admin HTTP RPC boundary makes this the best available owner for the security/product choice.
